title: Transcriptomic atlas reveals organ-specific disease tolerance in sickle cell mice
author: Grunenwald, Anne
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Select and genotype mice
steps.instruction: Use HbAA (control) and HbSS (sickle cell) Townes model mice that have been genotyped; choose age‑ and sex‑matched littermates that are 6–8 weeks old for the experiment.

steps.title: Anesthetize mice
steps.instruction: Place each mouse under isoflurane anesthesia at 2–3% concentration for all subsequent injections, blood collections, and sacrifice procedures.

steps.title: Inject hemin or PBS
steps.instruction: Inject hemin (Ferriprotoporphyrin IX) purchased from Frontiers Scientific intravenously into the retro‑orbital sinus at a dose of 24 µmol per kg body weight; inject control mice with an equal volume of PBS.

steps.title: Wait post‑injection
steps.instruction: Maintain mice under anesthesia as needed and allow a 4‑hour interval after injection before sacrifice.

steps.title: Sacrifice mice
steps.instruction: Euthanize all mice by cervical dislocation exactly 4 hours after the injection.

steps.title: Extract bone‑marrow RNA
steps.instruction: Harvest bone‑marrow tissue and isolate total RNA using the Macherey‑Nagel RNA extraction kit, following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality
steps.instruction: Measure RNA quantity and integrity on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer using the RNA 6000 Nano Kit; retain only samples with RNA Integrity Number (RIN) greater than 7 for downstream work.

steps.title: Prepare stranded mRNA libraries
steps.instruction: For each qualified sample, use 1 µg of total RNA (RIN > 7) with the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

substeps.instruction: Reverse‑transcribe fragmented mRNA using random primers.
Perform second‑strand synthesis replacing dTTP with dUTP to retain strand specificity.
Add a single A base to the cDNA ends.
Ligate Illumina adapters to the A‑tailed cDNA.

steps.title: Quantify and QC libraries
steps.instruction: Quantify each library by qPCR using the KAPA Library Quantification Kit for Illumina Libraries (KapaBiosystems, Wilmington, MA) and assess library size distribution with DNA High Sensitivity LabChip kits on an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Load the libraries onto an Illumina NextSeq 500 instrument and run a paired‑end 75‑base read V2 chemistry sequencing run.

steps.title: Primary data analysis
steps.instruction: Process raw sequencing data with AOZAN software (ENS, Paris) to demultiplex reads and perform quality control using FastQC modules (version 0.11.5).
